scenario_data.body: Epilogue 2
A few days have passed since the Platinum Idol Award ceremony
Aki is busy with her work as an idol, as always.
Now that Aki has fixed things with her mother, she's not anxious or worried anymore.
By the way.
If you're wondering what Kaede has been doing since reuniting properly with her daughter...
March. At the television station.

scenario_data.speaker: William
scenario_data.body: "Are you really quitting as Aki's support manager?"

scenario_data.speaker: Kaede
scenario_data.body: "Yes... I've talked to her manager, and resigned yesterday."

scenario_data.speaker: Kaede
scenario_data.body: "I'm going back to my old job."

scenario_data.speaker: Kaede
scenario_data.body: "Aki... probably doesn't need a support manager anymore."
Aki smiles wryly at that.

scenario_data.speaker: Aki
scenario_data.body: "That's true."

scenario_data.speaker: Aki
scenario_data.body: "My manager did say that."

scenario_data.speaker: Aki
scenario_data.body: "She said that she won't let me have a hard schedule that will require a support manager"

scenario_data.speaker: Aki
scenario_data.body: "Because the reason I worked so hard was to meet my mother..."

scenario_data.speaker: Aki
scenario_data.body: "And now I've met her."
Kaede hears this, and smiles in relief.

scenario_data.speaker: Kaede
scenario_data.body: "Aki... don't push yourself too hard."

scenario_data.speaker: Aki
scenario_data.body: "I know."

scenario_data.speaker: Kaede
scenario_data.body: "Let's try our best... at our respective places."

scenario_data.speaker: Aki
scenario_data.body: "Yeah."

scenario_data.speaker: Aki
scenario_data.body: "Well..."
For a moment, there is silence.
It's about time for Kaede to leave, but...

scenario_data.speaker: William
scenario_data.body: (Aki... is it really okay to not say goodbye?)

scenario_data.speaker: William
scenario_data.body: (A-Ah... she's probably nervous and can't say anything...)
Kaede smiles, like she has guessed the reason.
She pats a red-faced and hesitating Aki lightly on the head.

scenario_data.speaker: Kaede
scenario_data.body: "Bye then, Aki. I'll be going now."

scenario_data.speaker: Aki
scenario_data.body: "Y-Yeah..."

scenario_data.speaker: Kaede
scenario_data.body: "Don't catch a cold. Also, make sure that you eat properly."

scenario_data.speaker: Aki
scenario_data.body: "Yeah."
Kaede nods at me.

scenario_data.speaker: Kaede
scenario_data.body: "William. Thank you."

scenario_data.speaker: Kaede
scenario_data.body: "From now on... I hope you'll continue to look after Aki."

scenario_data.speaker: William
scenario_data.body: "Ah... y-yes!"

scenario_data.speaker: Kaede
scenario_data.body: "Goodbye then, Aki and William."
And then, Kaede turns away from us.
She tries to leave the room quietly, but...

scenario_data.speaker: Aki
scenario_data.body: "W-Wait!"
Aki yells out in a trembling voice.

scenario_data.speaker: William
scenario_data.body: "Aki."
*Squeeze!*
I gently take Aki's hand.
I squeezes it gently, hoping to give her strength.
Aki squeezes my hand back, shyly.
She turns to face her mother again.

scenario_data.speaker: Aki
scenario_data.body: "Mom."

scenario_data.speaker: Aki
scenario_data.body: "U-Um... I-I'll come and visit you sometimes...!"

scenario_data.speaker: Aki
scenario_data.body: "So when that happens... you can make me dinner!"
Kaede's eyes widen in surprise.
Finally she smiles in relief, and nods.

scenario_data.speaker: Kaede
scenario_data.body: "... Yes. I'll waiting for you."

scenario_data.speaker: Kaede
scenario_data.body: "I'll be waiting to make your favourite food for you...!"

scenario_data.speaker: Aki
scenario_data.body: "Yeah."

scenario_data.speaker: Aki
scenario_data.body: "See you later, Mom."

scenario_data.speaker: Kaede
scenario_data.body: "Yes... let's meet again, Aki."
Aki and her mother smile kindly at each other.
Their smiles are full of warmth and love, as if
to bury the 19 years that they couldn't smile at each other.
And then, on the way home after we said goodbye to Kaede.
Aki and I return to Famille together, but...

scenario_data.speaker: William
scenario_data.body: (I-I don't know what to say...)
It's not like it's awkward or anything.
However... it's hard to talk to Aki right now.

scenario_data.speaker: William
scenario_data.body: (Since we left the television station, she's been deep in thought...)

scenario_data.speaker: William
scenario_data.body: (After leaving her mother, Aki probably has a lot to think about...)
However, I end up talking because there's something I want to ask.

scenario_data.speaker: William
scenario_data.body: "H-Hey, Aki."

scenario_data.speaker: Aki
scenario_data.body: "What is it?"

scenario_data.speaker: William
scenario_data.body: "Um... I know we just said goodbye to Kaede, but..."

scenario_data.speaker: William
scenario_data.body: "Is it really okay for you to not live with your mother?"
Aki looks deep in thought again.
Finally, she smiles like she's made up her mind.

scenario_data.speaker: Aki
scenario_data.body: "It's fine."

scenario_data.speaker: Aki
scenario_data.body: "Mom and I... even if we're apart, we're fine."

scenario_data.speaker: Aki
scenario_data.body: "We both know that we'll always be thinking of each other."

scenario_data.speaker: William
scenario_data.body: "... I see."

scenario_data.speaker: Aki
scenario_data.body: "Also..."

scenario_data.speaker: William
scenario_data.body: "Hm?"

scenario_data.speaker: Aki
scenario_data.body: "The only place I can call home is where you are, William."

scenario_data.speaker: William
scenario_data.body: "A-Aki..."

scenario_data.speaker: Aki
scenario_data.body: "Hehe."
Aki's words and smile causes happiness to spread inside me.
I smile back at her, and squeeze her hand gently.

scenario_data.speaker: William
scenario_data.body: "Thanks, Aki...!"

scenario_data.speaker: Aki
scenario_data.body: "Yeah."
And then.
We continue walking for a few minutes... finally, we reach Famille.
I go to enter the house, but...
For some reason, Aki stops suddenly.
"What's wrong, Aki?"

scenario_data.speaker: William
scenario_data.body: "She's looking up at Famille happily."

scenario_data.speaker: Aki
scenario_data.body: "You know."

scenario_data.speaker: Aki
scenario_data.body: "The other day, we had a fight and things became awkward, right?"

scenario_data.speaker: William
scenario_data.body: "Ah... y-yeah."

scenario_data.speaker: Aki
scenario_data.body: "At that time, even though I was in Famille..."

scenario_data.speaker: Aki
scenario_data.body: "It didn't really feel like I was at home."

scenario_data.speaker: Aki
scenario_data.body: "But now we've made up..."

scenario_data.speaker: Aki
scenario_data.body: "It's like...... I've finally come home to where you are, William."

scenario_data.speaker: Aki
scenario_data.body: "That... makes me happy..."
I smile at Aki's quiet words.
I stand in front of the entrace to Famille.

scenario_data.speaker: Aki
scenario_data.body: "What is it......?"

scenario_data.speaker: William
scenario_data.body: "Aki."
I face Aki.
And then I say to her gently...

scenario_data.speaker: William
scenario_data.body: "Welcome home."
Aki sucks in her breath.
Finally, she looks a bit angry. with tears in her eyes.

scenario_data.speaker: Aki
scenario_data.body: "You idiot...!"

scenario_data.speaker: Aki
scenario_data.body: "Y-You can't just say things like that all of a sudden...!!"

scenario_data.speaker: Aki
scenario_data.body: "William..."

scenario_data.speaker: William
scenario_data.body: "Yeah."
This time, a lot has happened.
There were painful times too, but... we overcame those.
Aki runs over to embrace me,
like her happiness can't be contained within her small body.

scenario_data.speaker: Aki
scenario_data.body: "William...!!"
And then... we kiss passionately.
All I can do is accept Aki's desperate kiss.
She's so cute, and my love for her spreads in my chest.
Finally, our lips break apart, leaving only the aftertaste of happiness.
Aki's moist eyes gaze at me, and she smiles.

scenario_data.speaker: Aki
scenario_data.body: "William."

scenario_data.speaker: William
scenario_data.body: "Hm?"
Aki sends me a kind, sparkling smile...
And answers my words.
